why: No major reviewer or authority tests UPS units for NAS shutdown; the one famous name (Popular Mechanics) is a stale general UPS guide. The field is niche sites comparing on maker specs or unverifiable 'testing', affiliate listicles that all converge on the CP1500PFCLCD, a sizing explainer with no picks, and an off-target power-station page. A focused page with measured NAS-load runtimes, confirmed shutdown integration per NAS OS, current prices and a direct small-unit pick would stand out, as in our solar-kit win.
